projectDescription: A browser-based tool that converts images (JPG, PNG, WEBP) into alpha bead pattern matrices with color quantization, interactive editing, and multi-format export (PNG, Excel, CSV, HTML).
keyFeatures: Upload images via drag-and-drop or file picker (JPG, PNG, WEBP)
Configure pattern matrix dimensions (columns × rows, up to 500×500)
Aspect ratio lock to preserve original image proportions
Color similarity threshold to merge perceptually similar colors into fewer palette entries
Alpha/transparency threshold to cleanly handle semi-transparent image edges
Web Worker-based image processing to keep the UI responsive during pixel averaging
Interactive zoomable and pannable canvas preview with symbol labels per cell
Pencil tool for manually painting individual cells with palette colors or transparent
Full undo/redo history (stroke-level granularity) with undo-all and redo-all
Export to PNG (high-res), Excel XLSX, colored XLS (HTML), CSV, Google Sheets XLSX, and colored HTML
publicApiSurface: processImage(img, cols, rows, options) → { colorMatrix, paletteMap, symbolMatrix }
processImageAsync(img, cols, rows, options) → Promise<{ colorMatrix, paletteMap, symbolMatrix }>
